description: Asks, on a writable ACCDB copy, which column type spellings CREATE TABLE accepts through Database.Execute (dbFailOnError) and which DAO Field Type, Size and Attributes each gives: the Jet names (BYTE, SHORT, LONG, COUNTER, SINGLE, DOUBLE, CURRENCY, DATETIME, TEXT, MEMO, YESNO, GUID, BINARY, LONGBINARY) and the synonyms of other systems (TINYINT, SMALLINT, INT, INTEGER, REAL, FLOAT, MONEY, DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP, CHAR, VARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, NTEXT, LONGTEXT, LONGCHAR, BIT, BOOLEAN, LOGICAL, UNIQUEIDENTIFIER, IMAGE, OLEOBJECT, VARBINARY, BIGINT, DATETIME2 and the long spellings), with and without a length and at 0, 255 and 256. Each statement is CREATE TABLE Dt<i> (K LONG, C <type>); DBEngine.Errors follows, then each table's fields are read. Fixture r-def-expr-sql-main is opened on a writable fresh copy through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-expr-sql probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
